clip.motion: Hand-keyframed (not mocap): 2-bone IK legs with planted feet, torso lean 30 deg, barbell rides the upper back, hands grip the bar, fingers curled forward around the bar
clip.name: BarbellBackSquat
clip.timing: descend 0-1.2s (smootherstep), hold 1.2-1.6s, ascend 1.6-2.8s; first frame == last frame (loop closure max quat diff 0.0)

meshNotes.barbell: Procedural barbell (1.9 m bar, 2x 0.225 m plates, collars) parented to DEF-spine003, so it follows the torso. Included in the MESH file only, not the clip file.
meshNotes.look: Quaternius orange/purple mannequin (placeholder look, not a realistic athlete)

skeleton.note: Three.js GLTFLoader strips '.' from node names: DEF-thigh.L becomes DEF-thighL, DEF-spine.001 becomes DEF-spine001. Clip tracks use the STRIPPED names.

source: Quaternius Universal Animation Library (Standard), Godot GLB build — https://store.godotengine.org/asset/quaternius/universal-animation-library/download/44/ (pack page https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html)

verification.method: Headless Chromium (Playwright, SwiftShader WebGL) on this VM: loaded mesh GLB + clip GLB, played the clip on the mesh with THREE.AnimationMixer, measured bone positions and skinned bounds, screenshotted 5 frames (see proof/).
verification.note: No real Android device was available on this VM. Phone-webview playback (Capacitor) is NOT yet verified — needs the app worker's on-device check.
